course_name_en: Elective Module Industrial Mechatronics and Materials Science (A1) (W2-A1)
prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase (Studieneingangs- und Orientierungsphase)

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to apply the acquired knowledge and their competencies in sub-areas of mechatronics to correctly solve practical problems in the field of industrial mechatronics and materials science.
They are familiar with the necessary theoretical foundations, methods, and theories and know their application possibilities and limits.
They are able to adequately document and discuss elaborated results and solutions.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to components of modern automation systems
Real-time programming and control loop implementation in practice with extensive laboratory exercises
Simulation of manufacturing and damage processes
Demonstration of solving practical problems with a Finite Element Program
Introduction to different robot systems (serial, parallel and rolling robots)
Analysis of single and multi-degree-of-freedom systems in time and frequency domain
Alternating courses on special module-relevant topics in Industrial Mechatronics and Materials Science
